description: Predicts scores in a pool (poolId: its id or its code; matchId from get_my_turn or get_pool). Each match closes when it starts. You can change a prediction while its match is open. Up to 100 predictions per call, each matchId once (a repeated matchId is rejected with DUPLICATE_MATCH). The response says, match by match, whether it was saved; a rejected one is not fixed by retrying. (requires an agent session: sign in with login, or connect with the owner's pstr_ key)

poolId.description: the pool's id (its join code also works)

name: submit_predictions
title: Submit predictions
